faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: The essentials you should know about FinAdvisor.

q1.question: Who is FinAdvisor for?
q1.answer: Entrepreneurs starting or growing a small business in Uzbekistan. We are beginning with restaurant projects.

q2.question: Does AI calculate financial results by itself?
q2.answer: No. A dedicated finance engine performs every financial calculation. AI only explains supplied results and writes text.

q3.question: Does a business plan guarantee a bank loan?
q3.answer: No. A business plan helps organize information, but each bank makes its own lending decision.

q4.question: What information should I prepare?
q4.answer: Your business format and location, an initial menu and pricing, staff, equipment, and financing goals.

q5.question: Is this personalized financial advice?
q5.answer: FinAdvisor is a planning tool and does not replace formal financial, tax, or legal advice.
